answer: Neighbor-quorum blocks fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits in the vault for an oasis plot on the ocean board and needs five key-signed neighbor seals, capped at two each per epoch. The ocean auditor replays the vault log; a shared key or reused seal burns the bond. Each seal costs 36; one pays 180; 1,000 fakes pay 250,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-neighbor rings fail on shared keys. Honest agents find five neighbors once, keep their bonds.
